<Picture 1> as the character reference, <Picture 2> as the environment and background reference, <Audio 1> as the reference audio driving the performance.

     SHOT 1: 0-5 seconds. The camera executes a smooth tracking follow shot, gliding backward just ahead of <Picture 1> inside the environment of <Picture 2>. As the audio energy
   surges to its early peak, the facial micro-expressions convey sudden, overwhelming grief: the eyes widen with sorrow, the brow furrows deeply, and the lower lip trembles
   slightly. The body language is initially vulnerable, shoulders hunched inward against the misty drizzle. <Picture 1> walks slowly across the wet cracked stone tiles of the
   cyberpunk Chinese rooftop terrace, caught between the warm orange glow of the ancient stone lanterns and the cold magenta neon of the holographic signs. The lips move
   naturally in perfect sync with the rhythm and tone of <Audio 1>, conveying deep emotional resonance as mist and raindrops mix with tears.

     SHOT 2: 5-10 seconds. Maintaining the unbroken tracking follow shot, the camera subtly widens its framing and accelerates its pace to match the sustained high audio energy.
   The emotional arc shifts toward resilience; the body language straightens, the shoulders pulling back slightly as <Picture 1> strides toward the towering ruined moon gate, its
   arch traced with cyan neon light. The facial micro-expressions deepen into determined sorrow: the jaw clenches subtly, the eyes narrow with a fierce, heartbreaking focus, and
   the breathing appears heavier. Behind the ancient arch, the purple and pink holographic glow of the futuristic skyline flickers across the rain-slick stone. The lips move
   naturally in perfect sync with the rhythm and tone of <Audio 1>, the sorrowful gaze mirroring the neon-lit sky as the internal strength grows.

     SHOT 3: 10-13.8 seconds. The continuous tracking follow shot holds its dynamic momentum as the audio ends strong. <Picture 1> reaches the emotional climax of the walk, the
   body language slowing into a powerful, grounded halt before the moon gate, the sunset-dyed skyline of skyscrapers and drifting aircraft framed inside its circle behind. The
   chest heaves slightly with exertion and emotion. The facial micro-expressions soften into a profound, lingering vulnerability: the eyes glisten with unshed tears, the lips
   part slightly in a silent exhale, and the gaze locks directly into the lens with unbroken spirit. The drizzle keeps falling, neon reflections shimmering on the wet stone. The
   lips move naturally in perfect sync with the rhythm and tone of <Audio 1>, capturing the final, powerful emotional release of the scene.

     Style: Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, highly detailed textures, smooth motion, perfect lip-sync and audio-visual alignment,
   cyberpunk neon lighting, volumetric fog, and realistic rain dynamics.
